name: EPIC 229041262
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 14.5 solar radii and 1.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 10,776 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.94 solar masses and 14.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,039 K at its surface.
